scripts.build: npm run build -w @frame/sdk && npm run build -w @frame/browser && npm run build -w @frame/node && npm run build -w @frame/react
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run packages --pool forks --execArgv=--expose-gc --maxWorkers=2
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run check:pack
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings packages/sdk/src packages/browser/src packages/node/src packages/react/src examples/authoring/browser/src examples/document/web/src scripts
